title: ADLC performance, load and accessibility budgets
description: Schema for runs/<run-id>/enrichment/benchmarks.yaml. Declares, per metric, which evidence collector produces it, the budget it must respect, and whether lower or higher is better. Consumed by the L6 evidence collectors (lighthouse, k6, axe), which emit <collector>-measurements.json next to the raw tool output. A metric declared here but not produced by its collector is reported as not_run - never as a default value and never as a silent pass.

target.description: Defaults shared by every collector. Individual collectors may override.

url.description: Base URL of the running candidate build. May be overridden by the ADLC_TARGET_URL environment variable.

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock cap applied to each collector subprocess. Exceeding it yields not_run, never a fabricated value.

collectors.description: Per-collector execution options. Every key is optional; omitted collectors fall back to target.url plus documented defaults.

urls.description: Pages to audit. The first URL produces lighthouse.json; subsequent URLs produce lighthouse-1.json, lighthouse-2.json, ...

script.description: Path to an existing k6 script, resolved against the run directory then the repo root. When absent a minimal constant-VU GET script is generated into the evidence directory as k6-script.js.

url.description: Endpoint exercised by the generated script. Defaults to target.url.

env.description: Non-secret values forwarded as k6 --env KEY=VALUE. Never put credentials here: benchmarks.yaml is committed to the run directory.

urls.description: Pages to scan. The first URL produces axe.json; subsequent URLs produce axe-1.json, axe-2.json, ...

tags.description: axe-core rule tags to run, e.g. wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa, best-practice.

metrics.description: The budgets. Each entry becomes at most one normalised measurement.

id.description: Stable metric identifier. Well-known ids (lcp_ms, cls, tbt_ms, performance_score, p95_latency_ms, error_rate, a11y_critical_violations, ...) are extracted automatically; anything else MUST declare `source`.

collector.description: Which evidence collector produces this metric.

budget.description: Threshold the measured value is compared against.

direction.description: Comparison direction. lower_is_better passes when value <= budget; higher_is_better passes when value >= budget. Required - there is no safe default.

unit.description: Human-readable unit for reports, e.g. ms, %, count, score, KiB.

source.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the collector's raw output, e.g. /audits/largest-contentful-paint/numericValue or /metrics/http_req_duration/p(95). Required for ids outside the built-in catalogue; overrides the catalogue when present.

scale.description: Multiplier applied to the raw value before comparison. Used with `source` to convert units, e.g. 100 to turn a 0-1 Lighthouse score into 0-100.

aggregate.description: How to combine values when a collector audits several URLs. `worst` is max for lower_is_better and min for higher_is_better.

optional.description: Advisory only. A failing optional metric is reported but is not intended to block the evidence gate. Absence still yields not_run, never a pass.
